lane_pitch_limit.limit: the 11.5 mm wheel / rocker_main clearance holds on a level lane at the axle's height only: the gate (>= 10 mm) is lost at 0.14 % pitch or +1.5 mm of lane height, the wheel crosses the main from 1.1 % or +12 mm
lane_pitch_limit.same_margin_on_towers: DQ10-DQ20 and the ETDQ keep the same 11.5 mm on a level lane (S9); no geometry change
lane_pitch_limit.in_game_nose_train: level in the world: 0 % at anchor a; at most 0.17 % (-3 cm over the 17.7 m run to the wheel) at anchor d. The lane height is the open number: the HV anchors a..d rise 3.70..3.73 (prefab_numbers stub()), and a lane that takes b / c / d rides +10 / +20 / +30 mm above the axle (b: about 2 mm clear, c and d: crossed); which anchor each lane takes is unverified in game
lane_pitch_limit.basis: ChairPinSystem hangs every chair plumb (yaw-only rotation, ChairPinSystem.cs:201). LiftLoopCache (AppendTerminalTurn) runs the lane from the final span's end, the station-owned HV anchor (the train's outer tip, prefab z -12.125..-11.875), to the bullwheel tangent point as ONE straight 3D line; the wheel is at y 3.70. A CS2 building is a rigid body placed with yaw only (ObjectToolSystem.cs:3811-3816; StationAlign.cs:156), so that run is level in the world on any terrain. The stations do NOT flatten the ground (DECISIONS 7; the NO-LEVEL BuildingTerraformOverride, PIPELINE section 6): the level lane is the rigid mesh, not a flattened lot. The final span's grade (line envelope up to 0.9, SkiCatalog detachable row) ends at the anchors, before the first main rocker (x -11.88): a swept kink at -12.125 / -12.0 / -11.875 with 5-90 % grade keeps 11.5 mm.
